title: Batch Transform a Point Cloud
hints: Matrix3Xd: one matrix product plus a broadcast add, `(T.linear() * P).colwise() + T.translation()`. No loop needed.
std::vector: `out.reserve(pts.size())`, or construct with the right size, then a single loop. Hoist R and t out of the loop.
Raw buffer: `Eigen::Map<const Eigen::Matrix<float, 3, Eigen::Dynamic>, 0, Eigen::OuterStride<4>> P(xyzi, 3, n);` views x,y,z of each 4-float record without copying. Cast R and t to float.
